I need prepare website e-commerce

Summary

  • Built a complete starter e-commerce website with a sticky header, hero section, featured product grid, about section, checkout form, and a slide-in cart panel structure in index.html.

  • Added full responsive styling for layout, cards, buttons, checkout, cart panel behavior, and mobile breakpoints in styles.css.

  • Implemented interactive storefront behavior in script.js: product rendering, cart add/clear logic, live quantity and total updates, cart open/close state, and checkout validation/success flow.

  • Added project documentation with feature list and local run instructions in README.md.

  • Committed changes on branch work with commit 5be3822, and created a PR message via the make_pr tool.

Testing

  • ✅ node --check script.js

  • ✅ python3 -m http.server 8000 >/tmp/novacart-server.log 2>&1 & echo $!

  • ✅ mcp__browser_tools__run_playwright_script (ports_to_forward=[8000], screenshot: artifacts/novacart-home.png)

  • ✅ kill 3775

How to see results

Summary

  • Updated the documentation to explicitly answer “How to see results” with two paths: quick open via index.html and a recommended local server flow via python3 -m http.server 8000.

  • Added a concrete manual demo checklist so you can verify cart and checkout behavior step by step after launching the site.

  • Added a dedicated development validation section for JavaScript syntax checking (node --check script.js).

  • Committed the fix in b2d882e and created a PR message with the updated scope and checks.

Testing

  • ✅ node --check script.js

  • ✅ python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/tmp/novacart.log 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; sleep 1; (curl -I http://127.0.0.1:8000 | head -n 1) || true; kill $SERVER_PID; cat /tmp/novacart.log
